name: Cthulhu Detective
detailed_description:
Community

Join us in Discord unraveling eldritch mysteries!


About the Game

Developed by BattleCry Studio, Cthulhu Detective is a new kind of detective game that blends classic detective gameplay with supernatural horror. Set in a world where humans and gods collide, you will play as a rookie investigator, discover clues in every murders, dive into unscripted interrogations and uncover truths that break minds.

Beyond the traditional approach of presenting evidence and spotting contradictions, you’ll uncover multiple ways to corner the suspects, allows you to investigate freely. Along the way, discover hidden Easter eggs and encounter unpredictable events...with each revelation, the world feels... less human.

Gameplay and Features：

Shin Honkaku Mystery

Cthulhu Detective expands the possibilities of deduction games by integrating supernatural elements with authentic cases, pushing the joy of solving mysteries to the NEXT LEVEL.

Even Crimes Committed by Gods Leave Traces

In this fictional near-modern world touched by subtle Cthulhu mythos —a mysterious world where humans and gods coexist. The shadowy AIB (Agency of Investigating the Bizarre), containing and safeguarding unknown artifacts—lost relics of gods and forbidden powers. Meanwhile, in the city's darkest corners, desperate souls whisper about obtaining supernatural abilities. As a rookie investigator, you'll untangle this web of mysteries.

400,000 Words of Mystery

Dive into a sprawling narrative where intricate cases collide with unforgettable characters—every clue matters, every word counts.

But can you trust everything you see?

Multiple Paths to Catch the Killer

Tired of being stuck searching for that "one last piece of evidence"? Cthulhu Detective breaks free from rigid investigative structures. We offers a more flexible system that combines evidence collection and deduction seamlessly. Investigate the scene, connect the clues, and deduce at your own pace. Each case offers multiple solutions, allowing you to unravel the truth through different reasoning routes.
